name: Toy Soldiers: War Chest - Assassin’s Creed Pack
summary:
Command Assassin's Creed most popular hero in Toy Soldiers: War Chest - Ezio Auditore da Firenze. An ancestor of Desmond Miles and a charming Florentine nobleman who is good with a hidden blade AND the ladies, Ezio upholds the sacred creed with his Brotherhood of Assassins, a fierce alliance of justice and protection. The Assassins Creed army also includes these exciting and iconic units:

• Highly trained Assassins armed with throwing knives, explosives and other deadly weapons

• Attack from the skies with da Vinci’s Flying Machine

• Deal deadly blows to oncoming enemies with a giant anti-artillery cross bow

And many more upgrades and units, including some new never-before-seen inventions from Leonardo da Vinci!
